model: fusion: ResNet18 image features (frozen, cached) + TextCNN, concatenation -> MLP
selection_rule: median validation macro-F1 of seeds 0/1/2 among fusion TextCNN runs
why_this_config: Fusion was the best model family on validation. Fusion TextCNN and fusion BiLSTM tie on mean validation macro-F1 (0.8453 vs 0.8455, difference far below the seed std of 0.004-0.012); the tie is broken by training cost (TextCNN ~22 s / 2.7e-4 kWh vs BiLSTM ~33 s / 4.1e-4 kWh per run). Test scores were not used for this choice.
